topic: Adjusting age group data ranges for NZ
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adjusting existing City data age groups to better reflect New Zealand's drinking laws. The initial proposal was to consolidate the 5-year age buckets into two ranges: 0-19 years and 20-29 years.

Someone noted that while adjustments are possible, the original data structure (StatsNZ_CEN23_IND) uses detailed 5-year groups across a full range of ages (0 to 90+). The core technical constraint discussed was that any new grouping must cover the entire age spectrum to maintain data integrity.

Ultimately, the need for a comprehensive age range covering zero to 90+ years was confirmed.
decisions: The proposed two-group age structure (0-19 and 20-29) is not sufficient as it fails to cover the full required age range.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm the desired age grouping with the client before finalizing any changes.
